name: Future Stars Summer Day Camp at Villanova University Cabrini Campus
description_short: Future Stars day camp on Villanova University's Cabrini campus in Radnor for ages 5 to 13, with a traditional camp, an all sports camp, a sports camp for 5 and 6 year olds and STEAM camps. Campers use the 112 acre campus's fields, air conditioned spaces and indoor pool.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund by email through April 1, 2027. After that, a tuition credit less a $100 fee if you give at least two weeks' notice before the start date.
notes: Weekly rate $455 if registered by December 1, $495 after. Lunch fee $40 a week. Camp 9:00 to 3:00 with drop off 8:00 to 9:00 and pick up 3:00 to 3:15; extended time 7:00 to 8:00 ($5 a day) and 3:15 to 6:00 ($8 a day to 4:30, $16 to 6:00). Campers grouped by grade. The page gives the dates as June 14 to August 13 without a year; they are taken as 2027 because the same page's refund terms run through April 1, 2027 and June 14 falls on a Monday in 2027.
